prerequisite: When a whole layer of plan design lines sits at elevation 0, lift them to the design elevation before building TINs or grading
fixture_requirements: Several polylines at elevation 0 on one layer (verifies the layer + elevation blanket mode)
A few handles given different elevations individually (verifies elevation_by_handle overrides the global value)
A named handle that does not exist in the drawing (verifies the missing list is not silent)
assertions: In-memory change only: results must be kept with an explicit save_dwg
At least one of elevation and elevation_by_handle must be given, otherwise throw
At least one of layer / handles / elevation_by_handle must select objects, otherwise throw
Only Elevation changes: geometry, layer and other properties are untouched
Per-handle values in elevation_by_handle override the global elevation
Lines already at the target elevation count toward same and are not rewritten
Named handles that do not exist go to missing, never dropped silently
When nothing was changed, throw or report zero explicitly (no quiet success)

the 33rd line on the same layer (a 16 m fragment, handle D913) was not named and stayed at elevation 0 -- per-handle mode does not hit bystanders
